target_definition.definition: Original palette-index annotation !=0, including ID255 exactly as the existing DAVIS v2 union mask. Not the Synthetic designated layer target.
target_definition.resize: Read palette indices without grayscale conversion; INTER_NEAREST to1024x576, then labels!=0. RGB uses existing INTER_LINEAR original JPEG to1024x576 RGB uint8.
target_definition.multiple_instances: Union all nonzero IDs; use B largest8-connected component each frame. Report component label-ID counts and per-ID focused coverage. A component can contain several touching instances; selected component/instance can change across frames. No manual easier-instance choice or guarantee of all instances sharp.
target_definition.safe_region: Reuse safe_target_region: alpha>0.9, then>0.5, then>0; binary labels imply first threshold whenever nonempty. Largest8-connected component; equal area chooses earliest row-major component. Zero-padded exact Euclidean distance.
target_definition.point: Reuse medoid_point: native own predicted PNG8 depth nearest safe-region median; ties greatest exact boundary distance then row-major pixel.
target_definition.unavailable: Stop and record blocking scene/frame if the prescribed union target is empty or invalid. Do not change targets, propagate, exclude, or fill a formal table with a subset.
target_definition.permission: DAVIS annotation assists a single click outside the model; no GT numeric depth, GT alpha or target mask enters the generator. The native focus condition mask is computed from own predicted depth, not from annotation.

scope: Read input annotation/RGB only; no output viewing, model or metric execution
